projects.name: OmniSled Full Size
projects.notes:
Stock on hand is exactly one 48 x 96 sheet of 1/4 in plywood and one 48 x 96 sheet of 1/2 in plywood.
The 6 mm parts come off the 1/4 in sheet. There is no 3/4 in plywood on hand, so the fence parts land on the shopping list on purpose.
The packer is a heuristic. Check every measurement against your own stock before you cut anything.
